shortDescription: Educational trading research and coaching — not buy/sell signals.
fullDescription:
TradeInsight by Aithera helps discretionary traders research smarter, decide with clarity, and improve their process.

It is an educational research and coaching app: a Today brief, research-value queue, regime and market context, decision journal, replay, Decision Lab practice, Academy lessons, and explainable decision coaching. Scores measure research priority (Research Value Score, RVS) and decision-process quality (Decision Quality Score, DQS). They do not predict price direction.

Anyone may download and explore Guest mode. Creating an account or purchasing a subscription requires being at least 18 (or the age of majority where required). A Teen Play rating is content suitability only — it does not mean a minor may legally trade.

TradeInsight is not a broker, does not execute trades, does not handle real money, and does not provide buy/sell signals or investment advice.

Premium deepens radar, Trading DNA, Replay TV, portfolio intelligence, and export. Free remains a complete daily research product. Monthly and yearly subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled in Google Play subscription settings. Lifetime is not offered. Cancellation stops renewal while access continues through the store-reported paid-through date. The yearly plan includes a 7-day trial only when shown on the Google Play purchase sheet.

Features:
• Decision Brief and research-value queue
• Journal, replay, and process review
• Explainable decision coaching (not signals)
• Educational Academy and risk-free Decision Lab practice
• Portfolio context and risk tools (Premium)
• Price alerts and economic calendar
